description: Header file defining classes and enums for coordinated channel access (CAC) task and FSM in the prplMesh project, including class declarations for CacFsm and CoordinatedCacTask, and related enums and includes.

classes.name: CacFsm
classes.description: Finite state machine class managing CAC process states and events.

classes.name: CoordinatedCacTask
classes.description: Task class handling coordinated CAC operations and events.

methods.name: CacFsm
methods.description: Constructor for CacFsm, initializes FSM with task pool, backhaul manager, and message transmitter.

methods.name: send_switch_channel_request
methods.description: Sends a switch channel request with specified channel and bandwidth.

methods.name: send_cac_request
methods.description: Sends a CAC request for a given radio.

methods.name: is_timeout_waiting_for_switch_channel_report
methods.description: Checks if timeout occurred while waiting for switch channel report.

methods.name: is_timeout_waiting_for_cac_termination
methods.description: Checks if timeout occurred while waiting for CAC termination.

methods.name: CoordinatedCacTask
methods.description: Constructor for CoordinatedCacTask, initializes task with task pool, backhaul manager, and message transmitter.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Handles task events, both by enum value and shared pointer.
